Title: TechniqueRAG: Retrieval Augmented Generation for Adversarial Technique Annotation in Cyber Threat Intelligence Text
Objective: Automate ATT&CK technique extraction from unstructured CTI text
Methodology: Zero-shot RAG with instruction-tuned LLMs and learned reranking
Findings: RAG significantly outperforms vanilla LLMs in technique mapping
Relevance_to_ThreatRAG: Direct foundation for ThreatRAG ATT&CK retrieval

Title: H-TechniqueRAG: Hierarchical Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Fine-Grained ATT&CK Technique Mapping
Objective: Address taxonomy complexity in technique identification
Dataset: Enterprise ATT&CK corpus and real-world threat reports
Methodology: Two-stage hierarchical retrieval (tactics then nested techniques)
Metrics: Top-k Recall nDCG Latency API Cost
Findings: Reduces candidate search space by 60% and improves top-5 precision
Relevance_to_ThreatRAG: Informs ThreatRAG's adaptive query routing

Title: CyberRAG: An Agentic RAG Cyber Attack Classification and Reporting Tool
Objective: Reduce SOC alert fatigue via agentic attack classification and report generation
Dataset: SOC telemetry and CTF incident reports
Methodology: Multi-agent iterative retrieval and reasoning loop
Findings: Agentic loops outperform single-pass RAG on complex attack narratives
Relevance_to_ThreatRAG: Guides ThreatRAG's LangGraph multi-agent architecture

Title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Large Language Models: A Survey
Objective: Comprehensive taxonomy of Naive Advanced and Modular RAG
Methodology: Categorization of retrieval indexing and generation paradigms
Findings: Hybrid retrieval and modular reranking are critical to production RAG
Relevance_to_ThreatRAG: Provides theoretical architectural blueprint

Title: Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve Generate and Critique through Self-Reflection
Objective: Enable LLMs to selectively retrieve and self-evaluate evidence
Methodology: Reflection tokens for retrieval need and claim support verification
Findings: Self-critique drastically reduces hallucinations and unneeded retrievals
Limitations: High training complexity for reflection tokens
Relevance_to_ThreatRAG: Informs ThreatRAG's evidence validation and citation auditing

Title: Corrective Retrieval Augmented Generation (CRAG)
Objective: Self-correct retrieval errors via evaluator and web search fallback
Methodology: Lightweight retrieval evaluator scoring document relevance
Findings: Robust recovery when local index lacks sufficient evidence
Relevance_to_ThreatRAG: Validates ThreatRAG's fallback and abstention mechanism

Title: RAGAS: Automated Evaluation of Retrieval Augmented Generation
Objective: Reference-free automated evaluation of RAG systems
Methodology: Metric formulation: Faithfulness Answer Relevance Context Precision
Findings: Faithfulness and Context Precision accurately track hallucination
Relevance_to_ThreatRAG: Serves as ThreatRAG's generation evaluation standard

Title: Reciprocal Rank Fusion Outperforms Condorcet and Individual Rank Learning Methods
Objective: Robust rank fusion across diverse retrieval models
Methodology: RRF score accumulation based on 1/(k + rank)
Findings: Consistently outperforms weighted linear sum without hyperparameter tuning
Relevance_to_ThreatRAG: Direct mathematical foundation for ThreatRAG hybrid fusion

Title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
Objective: Replace BM25 with dual-encoder dense semantic embeddings
Methodology: Bi-encoder bert embeddings with contrastive loss
Findings: Dense retrieval excels at semantic paraphrasing and conceptual match
Limitations: Fails on exact keyword identifiers and hashes
Relevance_to_ThreatRAG: Justifies ThreatRAG's dense retrieval branch

Title: The Probabilistic Relevance Framework: BM25 and Beyond
Objective: Theoretical and practical foundation of BM25 lexical ranking
Methodology: Probabilistic term-frequency saturation and length normalization
Findings: Gold standard for exact term matching and technical tokens
Relevance_to_ThreatRAG: Core component of ThreatRAG's sparse retrieval branch

Title: ThreatKG: A System for Automated Open-Source CTI Gathering and Knowledge Graph Construction
Objective: Automated extraction of structured threat knowledge from OSCTI
Methodology: Hierarchical ontology with deep learning entity relation extraction
Findings: Constructs actionable graphs connecting threat actors tools and CVEs
Limitations: Graph query latency can be high
Relevance_to_ThreatRAG: Informs ThreatRAG's structured metadata extraction

Title: AttacKG: Constructing Technique Knowledge Graph from CTI Reports
Objective: Construct technique-level attack behavior graphs
Methodology: Graph alignment with MITRE ATT&CK techniques
Findings: Automated mapping of complex multi-stage attack procedures
Relevance_to_ThreatRAG: Validates structured security event matching

Title: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
Objective: Analyze and resolve miscalibration in modern deep models
Methodology: Temperature scaling Platt scaling and vector scaling
Findings: Modern overparameterized models are severely overconfident
Limitations: Requires holdout validation set for temperature tuning
Relevance_to_ThreatRAG: Theoretical basis for ThreatRAG confidence calibration

Title: Probabilistic Outputs for Support Vector Machines
Objective: Transform raw classification scores into calibrated probabilities
Methodology: Logistic sigmoid mapping of decision margins
Findings: Effective post-hoc parametric probability transformation
Relevance_to_ThreatRAG: Implemented in ThreatRAG Phase 7 calibration

Title: Transforming Classifier Scores into Accurate Multiclass Probability Estimates
Objective: Non-parametric probability calibration for general classifiers
Methodology: Isotonic regression (PAV algorithm)
Metrics: Log loss Mean Squared Error Calibration error
Findings: Does not assume sigmoid shape; handles non-monotonic margins
Limitations: Prone to overfitting on small sample sizes
Relevance_to_ThreatRAG: Second calibration algorithm evaluated in ThreatRAG

Title: Toward Generating a New Intrusion Detection Dataset (CIC-IDS2017)
Objective: Generate realistic updated network flow dataset
Dataset: Full capture network PCAP and bidirectional flow CSVs
Methodology: B-profile and M-profile traffic generation on testbed
Metrics: Flow duration Packet size Inter-arrival statistics
Findings: Contains 14 modern attack classes alongside benign background
Limitations: Class imbalance and duplicate flow artifacts
Relevance_to_ThreatRAG: Primary intrusion dataset used in ThreatRAG

Title: A Unified Approach to Interpreting Model Predictions (SHAP)
Objective: Unified framework for interpretable machine learning predictions
Dataset: Tree and deep neural model benchmarks
Methodology: Shapley value approximation with TreeSHAP and KernelSHAP
Metrics: Local fidelity Axiomatic consistency Computation time
Findings: Provides mathematically unique consistent local explanations
Relevance_to_ThreatRAG: Used for feature attribution in ThreatRAG threat identification

Title: Why Should I Trust You?: Explaining Predictions of Any Classifier (LIME)
Objective: Local interpretable model-agnostic explanations
Methodology: Sparse linear local surrogate models on perturbed instances
Findings: Fast local explanations that human analysts readily interpret
Relevance_to_ThreatRAG: Complementary explanation tool in ThreatRAG

Title: UNSW-NB15: A Comprehensive Data Set for Network IDS
Objective: Modern synthetic-realistic hybrid network intrusion benchmark
Methodology: Contemporary low footprint attack simulation
Metrics: F1 Detection Rate False Alarm Rate
Findings: Captures subtle modern attack signatures better than KDD99
Relevance_to_ThreatRAG: Secondary validation dataset for ThreatRAG

Title: Automating Cyber Threat Triage and MITRE ATT&CK Mapping Using Multi-Agent Graph Frameworks
Objective: Orchestrate multi-agent threat triage with MITRE ATT&CK grounding
